Name: Forewarn
Effect: In battle, this Pokémon will warn of the strongest Move/Maneuver one the opposing Foes has. The first time that Move/Maneuver is used, if this Pokémon is in Battle ignore all Damage and other effects from it.
Description: When this Pokémon feels bad intentions or disaster approaching, it will mentally warn its trainer. The trainer must make a roll of Insight to get the message.
